title: Divorce without children: basic intake
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. For spouses ending a marriage who explicitly report no children. The invented draft collects both names, the filing person's address, marriage and separation dates, and the requested outcome. Confirm that this child-free situation is stated; silence about children is not confirmation.

title: Divorce without children: wedding date corrected
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. A caller first gives one wedding date and then replaces it during the same intake. Use the later explicit correction for marriage_date, retain the earlier statement in the history, and cite both source positions. This invented checklist still needs the ordinary divorce facts.

title: Divorce without children: separation date uncertain
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. The spouses have no children, but the caller can only estimate when they stopped living together. Keep separation_date unresolved for human review instead of converting a season, month, or guess into an exact day. Preserve what the caller actually remembers.

title: Divorce without children: filing address missing
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. The caller wants to end a marriage without children but has not supplied a current address for the filing person. Route petitioner_address for review. A former residence or the other spouse's location is not a replacement unless the caller confirms it.

title: Divorce without children: other spouse cannot be located
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. The filing person knows their own address but cannot locate the other spouse. The invented location addendum asks for respondent_address separately. Leave it unresolved when unknown; do not manufacture an address, a delivery method, or a legal procedure.

title: Divorce without children: shared home
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. The child-free spouses still own or rent one home together. The invented property paragraph needs a property_summary describing the dwelling and the caller's requested treatment. Do not infer ownership, value, or who should receive the home.

title: Divorce without children: shared borrowing
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. The child-free spouses want the draft to mention a loan, credit balance, or other borrowing they both discuss. Record the debt in property_summary using only stated details. A request to divide a balance does not establish who legally owes it.

title: Divorce without children: private contact preference
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. The caller reports no children and asks that follow-up avoid a shared telephone or email account. The invented contact box needs contact_preference in the caller's own terms. A privacy preference does not supply a missing residential address.

title: Divorce without children: two current households
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. The spouses without children now live at two known residences. The invented address comparison records petitioner_address and respondent_address separately. Keep each location attached to the correct person rather than selecting the first address mentioned.

title: Divorce without children: requested former surname
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. The caller ending a child-free marriage also wants the invented draft to mention a return to a former surname. Collect the exact requested_name and former_name as well as the ordinary divorce facts. Do not promise that a name will be changed.

title: Divorce with children: basic intake
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. For a caller ending a marriage who explicitly identifies children of that marriage. The invented draft needs both adult names, the filing person's address, marriage and separation dates, requested outcome, and a separate child record containing each child's name and birth date.

title: Divorce with children: children with similar names
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. Two or more children have nearly identical given names, such as a one-letter spelling difference. Keep separate children records and match each birth date to its stated child. Shared surnames, list order, or resemblance between names do not establish identity.

title: Divorce with children: child birth date corrected
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. During a divorce intake, the caller explicitly replaces a birth date previously given for one child. Use the later corrected date for that child while preserving both statements and their source lines. Do not apply the correction to a sibling.

title: Divorce with children: child birth date uncertain
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. The caller identifies a child but is unsure of the exact birthday. Keep that child's birth date unresolved and send it for review. An approximate age, school year, or remembered month must not become an invented complete date.

title: Divorce with children: incomplete child list
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. The caller says the marriage has children but gives no names or leaves one child out of the details. The invented draft still needs individual children records. Request the missing information; do not turn the phrase our children into a guessed count or identity.

title: Divorce with children: alternating weeks proposed
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. The caller proposes children spending alternate full weeks with each parent after the divorce. The invented arrangement paragraph asks for parenting_schedule, including any stated handover day. Describe it as a request, never as an agreed arrangement without confirmation.

title: Divorce with children: school nights and weekends
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. The caller proposes one home for school nights and another for weekend visits while ending the marriage. Record the requested parenting_schedule and any stated pickup or return times. Do not translate a broad weekend preference into specific hours.

title: Divorce with children: different schedules for siblings
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. The caller requests different living or visiting arrangements for two siblings. The invented parenting_schedule must associate each requested arrangement with the correct child. Do not copy one child's proposed schedule to the other child automatically.

title: Divorce with children: first holiday proposal
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. During a divorce intake, the caller proposes how school holidays, birthdays, or festival days should be shared. The invented parenting_schedule records the specific requested occasions and timing. An unspecified holiday must stay unspecified.

title: Divorce with children: proposed handover location
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. The caller ending a marriage identifies a place where the parents would exchange the children. The invented draft includes exchange_location alongside the child details. Distinguish a proposed meeting place from a parent's home address.

title: Custody change: basic existing-arrangement intake
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. For a caller asking to modify an existing parenting arrangement rather than start a divorce. The invented draft needs both adult names, the filing person's address, child records, the prior_order_date, and requested_change. Do not infer the contents of an existing order.

title: Custody change: prior order date unknown
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. The caller describes an existing parenting order but cannot give its date. Keep prior_order_date unresolved for review. A hearing, filing, or separation date is not automatically the date of that order; retain the distinction in the invented intake.

title: Custody change: order identifier missing
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. The caller knows the date of an existing parenting order but cannot locate its document identifier. The invented order lookup box asks for order_reference separately from prior_order_date. Route the unknown identifier for review instead of constructing a plausible number.

title: Custody change: parent moving away
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. A parent plans to move farther away and requests a change to an existing parenting arrangement. The invented relocation_details box records the stated destination, timing, and requested effect on visits. Missing distance or travel duration must not be calculated from guesses.

title: Custody change: child changing school
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. A child's new school location or timetable is the reason for changing an existing parenting arrangement. Describe the stated school change in requested_change and record the proposed parenting_schedule. Do not assume that a new school automatically changes an order.

title: Custody change: work shift has changed
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. A parent's new working hours make the existing visiting timetable difficult. The invented parenting_schedule captures the proposed replacement times, and requested_change explains the work conflict. Keep the current arrangement separate from what the caller wants next.

title: Custody change: replace handover location
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. The caller wants an existing child-exchange location replaced with a different meeting place. Record the proposed exchange_location and explain the requested_change. Do not silently treat the proposed place as the location already required by the current arrangement.

title: Custody change: revise holiday allocation
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. The caller wants to change how an existing parenting arrangement allocates school holidays or special days. Record the requested parenting_schedule, identifying which occasions differ from the current plan. Do not infer agreement from the other parent's silence.

title: Custody change: travel and transport request
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. The caller wants an existing parenting arrangement changed because collecting and returning the children requires substantial travel. The invented requested_change describes the transport request, and parenting_schedule records stated timing. Do not invent costs or driving durations.

title: Custody change: preferred parent communication
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. The caller wants a different way for parents to communicate under an existing parenting arrangement. The invented contact_preference records the requested channel or contact times. Preserve requested_change without assuming either parent has already accepted the proposal.

title: Adult name change: basic intake
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. For an adult asking for a different name without a divorce or parenting change. The invented draft needs the current name, current address, birth date, exact requested_name, and reason_for_change. This checklist does not describe any real jurisdiction's name-change requirements.

title: Adult name change: correct a spelling
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. An adult wants a spelling error corrected in the name used for this demonstration. Record the exact requested_name and a spelling_note showing which letters differ from the current name. Do not silently correct spelling based on what seems more familiar.

title: Adult name change: return to a former name
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. An adult wants a standalone name change back to a name previously used. Record former_name and exact requested_name in addition to current identity details. Do not assume that the former name is a birth name or that a divorce is involved.

title: Adult name change: personally chosen identity
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. An adult has selected a name that better fits their identity and asks for a standalone demonstration draft. Record the exact requested_name and the caller's stated reason_for_change. No private explanation beyond what the caller chooses to give should be invented.

title: Adult name change: hyphenated family name
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. An adult wants a surname containing a hyphen or two joined family names. The invented spelling_note records the exact punctuation, ordering, and spacing stated for requested_name. Do not reorder components or drop the hyphen for convenience.

title: Adult name change: one-word requested name
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. An adult requests a name made of one word. Preserve the exact requested_name as stated for this fictional template. Do not generate a surname or split the single name into invented given-name and family-name fields.

title: Adult name change: birth date uncertain
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. An adult requesting a standalone name change is unsure of their complete birth date. Keep birth_date unresolved for human review. A recalled year or an approximate age must not be expanded into a guessed day and month.

title: Adult name change: current address missing
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. An adult requests a name change but has not given a current address. Route petitioner_address to a person for review. An old address on a document or an address belonging to a friend is not a confirmed current address.

title: Adult name change: documents use different names
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. An adult says a diploma, identity document, or other record uses a name different from the name they currently use. The invented document_name box preserves the name written on that record separately from petitioner_name and requested_name.

title: Adult name change: correspondence sent elsewhere
jurisdiction: Republic of Alderhaven — Fictional Demonstration Jurisdiction
body: Fictional Alderhaven demo. An adult requesting a new name wants correspondence sent somewhere other than the stated home address. The invented address_note records the separate mailing instruction. Preserve petitioner_address and avoid replacing it with a contact address without confirmation.
